# CANDIDATE: VIX_INTRADAY_MEAN_REVERT_SHORT

**Filed:** 2026-07-09  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** new_trigger  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Intraday spikes in VIX above its short‑term mean often precede short‑term mean‑reversion in SPY, especially when price shows bearish engulfing at a named resistance level with elevated RSI. This strategy aims to capture that mean‑reversion move by entering short on the bar that triggers the VIX spike and bearish engulfing confluence.

## Mechanism

Entry when the 1‑minute VIX exceeds its 20‑period EMA by at least one VIX ATR(5) **AND** the SPY 5‑minute close is below VWAP **AND** forms a bearish engulfing candle at a named resistance level (prior‑day high, weekly high, or prior‑day low if short‑biased) **AND** RSI(14) > 60. Enter short at the close of that bar. Exit: stop placed above the higher of the recent swing high or the named resistance level; target 1.5× risk or exit when VIX falls back below its 20‑period EMA. Regime filter: only active when VIX > 15 and after 10:30 ET; avoid low‑VIX (<12) regimes.
